notes: Vanilla Elemental at 60: Flame Shock kept ticking, Lightning Bolt spammed the rest of the time, Chain Lightning taking over on 2+ targets, with Searing Totem or Magma Totem dropped depending on target count, and Earth Shock as a mana-percent-gated filler -- matching the community guide's 'totems up, Flame Shock up, then Lightning Bolt' summary; Earth Shock as a mana dump is our own design choice, matching the enhancement rotation's own precedent, not something the guide says. The fork's elemental_shaman/apls/default.apl.json is the starting point but two lines are not adapted as-is: it casts Chain Lightning (10605) with no target-count condition ahead of Lightning Bolt in the priority list, which would fire Chain Lightning on every single-target cast too since it has no ability cooldown of its own -- gated it on numberTargets >= 2 here instead. It also filled its Lightning Bolt line with rank 4 (915) rather than the top rank; used rank 10 (15208), the highest this build's spellconst has, since nothing here calls for downranking. Fix round 1: the first pass here left Earth Shock out over an assumed shared cooldown with Chain Lightning; that assumption was wrong. Read sim/shaman/shocks.go and sim/shaman/chain_lightning.go directly: registerShocks() shares one shockTimer across Earth Shock, Flame Shock, and Frost Shock only, while registerChainLightningSpell() owns an independent cdTimer never tied to that shared timer -- the category_cooldown_ms: 6000 spellconst reports for both the shocks and Chain Lightning is coincidental, not a shared category. A priority list already skips an on-cooldown action and falls through, so Earth Shock is added back as a mana-percent-gated filler ahead of the Lightning Bolt default, the same placement the preset used it in and the same design our own enhancement rotation already uses -- not something the cited guide itself recommends. All non-cast aura references here are dotIsActive checks against Searing Totem (10438), Magma Totem (10587), and Flame Shock (29228); each is registered with its Dot directly on the same spell object as its own ActionID (sim/shaman/fire_totems.go, sim/shaman/flame_shock.go), not via a separate buff-aura helper, so dotIsActive resolves correctly for all three -- verified the same way the enhancement fix below required for Windfury Totem, which does not have this direct self-reference.

sources.label: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Classic PvE Elemental Shaman guide

priorityList.notes: Single target: Searing Totem is the higher damage fire totem.
2 or more targets: Magma Totem hits everyone standing in it instead.
Keep Flame Shock on the target; it is cheap relative to its damage and does not compete with the GCD budget much.
2 or more targets: Chain Lightning hits all of them for close to single-target Lightning Bolt damage.

Earth Shock is a mana dump once mana is comfortably above half; it shares a cooldown with Flame Shock only, not Chain Lightning, so it is safe to slot in here. Fix round: the 50% gate never once passed under this build's bare (no mp5 gear, no talents, no consumables) mana curve -- SecondsOomAvg is ~138s of a 180s fight at 60, i.e. this character is fully out of mana for roughly three-quarters of the encounter, so mana only sits above half for a brief window right at pull before crashing and never recovering. Instrumented thresholds from 50% down to 10% at level 60 (2000 iterations, smokeSeed): 50% never casts Earth Shock (dps=50.48); 30%, 20%, and 10% are indistinguishable from each other (each casts Earth Shock 0.835/iteration, dps=49.80, Lightning Bolt casts 68.9-69.6, essentially unchanged from the 50% baseline's 69.6) -- the mana curve crosses all three of those thresholds within the same brief early-fight window, so nothing below 30% buys anything further. Lowered to 30%, the highest value that actually lets the line fire, rather than pushing lower for no additional casts. This still is not "a few times a fight" (0.835/iteration under this deliberately bare build) and costs about 0.7 dps (1.4%) relative to never casting it, but the alternative is a rotation line that is provably dead code at every threshold this build can reach; a geared, buffed Elemental shaman with real mp5 will cross 30% mana far more often than this smoke build does.
Lightning Bolt is the rest of the single-target rotation.
